name: Crispy Chicken Coating Mix
description: A dry mix for coating chicken, made with bread crumbs, spices, and herbs.
recipeIngredient: 30 mL vegetable oil (not used in mix, possibly for instructions not given)

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all dry ingredients (bread crumbs, celery salt, garlic powder, pepper, sage, paprika, thyme) in a bowl.
Rub the mixture together well to ensure even distribution of ingredients.
Store the mix in a tightly sealed container.

keywords: chicken coating, crispy chicken, breading mix

_similar.name: Chicken Breast
_similar.description: A simple breaded chicken breast recipe.

recipeInstructions.text: Wash chicken breast.
Sprinkle with garlic powder, salt, and seasoning.
Dip in milk, then egg mixture, then bread crumbs.
Bake in a 9x13 inch pan at 350°F until golden.
Serve with rice or noodles.

_similar.name: Chicken Supreme
_similar.description: A hearty chicken dish with tomatoes, herbs, and cheese, baked to perfection and served over rice or pasta.

recipeInstructions.text: Boil the chicken breasts in a separate container until pink is gone (about 1/4 of the way cooked).
In a baking or roasting pan, mix together the tomato ingredients (stewed tomatoes, green pepper, onion, basil, oregano, garlic).
Place the partially cooked chicken breasts in the bottom of the pan.
Sprinkle spices over the chicken breasts.
Pour the remaining tomato mixture on top of the chicken breasts.
Cover and bake at 350°F for approximately ½ hour.
Sprinkle grated cheese on top, cover, and bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Serve over rice or pasta.

_similar.keywords: chicken supreme, baked chicken, Italian-style chicken

_similar.name: Chicken Glazed with Basil & Balsamic Vinegar
_similar.description: A glazed chicken breast recipe with basil, balsamic vinegar, and honey.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Place chicken breasts in a shallow baking dish.
In a saucepan, bring remaining ingredients to a boil.
Remove from heat and pour over chicken.
Bake for 20-30 minutes or until chicken is cooked, basting occasionally with the glaze.
Serve warm or cold.

_similar.name: Easy Curried Chicken
recipeIngredient: Broccoli and carrots, cut into bite-size pieces

recipeInstructions.text: Grease the bottom of a pan and layer with vegetables.
Arrange chicken pieces on top of the vegetables.
Mix cream of chicken soup, mayonnaise, and curry powder.
Pour the soup mixture over the chicken.
Sprinkle bread crumbs on top.
Bake at 375°F for 1 hour.

_similar.keywords: curried chicken, creamy chicken, baked chicken casserole

_similar.name: Classy Chicken
_similar.description: A creamy, curry-flavored chicken dish with asparagus or broccoli and a cheddar cheese topping.
recipeIngredient: 1 (10 oz) pkg frozen asparagus or broccoli

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the chicken into 2×4 inch pieces and sprinkle with pepper.
Saute the chicken slowly in oil over medium heat until white and clear, about 6 minutes. Drain.
Cook asparagus or broccoli until tender crisp, drain, and arrange in the bottom of a buttered 7-inch diameter casserole dish.
Place the cooked chicken on top of the asparagus or broccoli layer.
Mix the cream of chicken soup, mayonnaise, curry powder, and lemon juice together and pour over the chicken.
Sprinkle the grated cheddar cheese over the top.
Bake, uncovered, at 375 °F for 30 to 35 minutes.

_similar.keywords: creamy chicken, curry chicken, asparagus, cheddar cheese
